facts.fact: Hattie 开车回家途中瞥了一眼副驾驶座上的马尼拉文件夹，觉得它像危险物。
facts.anchor: Hattie glances at the passenger seat where the manila folder lies.

facts.fact: 手机收到旧号码发来的消息，但 Hattie 因离家只剩五分钟而没读。
Hattie 回到家，Tommy 抱着胳膊靠在厨房台面上，表情让她停住。
facts.anchor: Tommy’s leaning against the kitchen counter, arms crossed.

facts.fact: Tommy 告诉刚到家的 Hattie：Wendy 来过。
Tommy 说听到脚步后躲起来，撞到走廊边桌，Wendy 因此进了屋。
facts.anchor: I bumped into the end table in the hall.

facts.fact: Hattie 想起几年前和 Crawfords 一家换过应急备用钥匙。
facts.anchor: She’d almost forgotten exchanging keys with the Crawfords a few years back in case of emergencies.

facts.fact: Tommy 说 Wendy 叫了 Hattie 的名字，语气听起来很担心。
facts.anchor: She said your name. She sounded worried.

facts.fact: Hattie 看到笔记本电脑开着，屏幕显示 Paige McMahon 的照片及关于她谋杀案的文章，旁边还有笔记和 Eeling 的文件打印件。
facts.anchor: displaying Paige McMahon’s face above an article concerning her murder.
